column1: # Pterohost WG local network hostname map.
# Update this file and rebuild the images when a node is added or relocated.
# The authority for this list is the panel, not this file. Every IP a container
# can see itself on is an allocation IP, so the list must equal:
#   SELECT DISTINCT a.ip, n.fqdn FROM allocations a JOIN nodes n ON n.id = a.node_id;
# When it does not, sysinfo.sh falls through to reverse DNS and then to the bare
# container hostname, and the boot banner names the wrong machine - or no machine.
# node03 and node04 were missing here from the day they were added, which is why
# their containers could never name themselves.
